en:
Wh-What does a degenerate male
want from me!?
Hmmmmmm...

Well, it doesn't seem like you're talking
to me cuz of an ulterior motive.
So you better get it straight, okay?

If you even *think* of doing something weird,
my Neo-Aikido skills will end your life!

Himiko...Himiko...
Himiko, Himiko, Himiko!
Spend time together
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Tenko?
Spend time together
Go on a date
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Tenko?

Are males waging a war on girls?
It's kill or be killed, is that it!?

Then I will not go down without a fight!
Come at me!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent considerable time convincing
Tenko not to hurt me...

Is it possible for a degenerate to talk to
me without an ulterior motive...?

Maybe you mastered your facial muscles to
prevent me from reading your thoughts!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time explaining to
Tenko that I had no ulterior motives.

Well...I suppose I don't have to worry about
you, Shuichi.

But there's still a chance you might attack
me when my guard is down...

Just in case, please do not come near me
within a 10 feet radius!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent the next few hours carefully
keeping my distance from Tenko.
Why is Himiko so cute?

Without a doubt, she is so perfect...
She is my image of the ideal girl!

Even if you are just a degenerate, you must
understand how cute Himiko is, right!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko and I spent quite some time
discussing how cute Himiko is.
<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko and I grew a little closer today.
